evidence.quote: the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 2-1/4 to 2-1/2 percent
the Committee will closely monitor the implications of incoming information for the economic outlook and will act as appropriate to sustain the expansion
uncertainties about this outlook have increased
overall inflation and inflation for items other than food and energy are running below 2 percent
indicators of business fixed investment have been soft
Voting against the action was James Bullard, who preferred at this meeting to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 25 basis points.
